# Vendored LZ4

- Upstream: <https://github.com/lz4/lz4>
- Version: 1.10.0 (`v1.10.0`)
- License: BSD 2-Clause; see `inst/COPYRIGHTS` and the source headers.
- Local modifications: none.

The source and header are kept together here to make their third-party origin
explicit. When updating LZ4, replace both files from the same upstream release
and update the version recorded above and in `inst/COPYRIGHTS`.
